Tide pool field notes

Low tide came at 06:42. Calm water, clear skies and strong light wind. A soft line break joins this line to the one before it.
A backslash at the end of a line is a hard break.

Species seen

  • Ochre sea star

  • Giant green anemone

  • Hermit crab

    • in a borrowed whelk shell

  1. Arrive before the turn of the tide

  2. Step only on bare rock

print(sum(counts.values()))

Send reports to www.tidepools.example or to logs@tidepools.example, or read https://tidepools.example/guide first.
